page.overview:
Who is Pomona Bazaar?

Pomona Bazaar (née Krupp) is the daughter of Remus Krupp and Fernice Schedeen, the wife of Walter Bazaar and the mother of Alberta, Hazel and Violet Bazaar.

She most likely lives in Springfield like the Simpsons due to the fact that two of her three daughters are seen.
